decisions.reason: The quantity of products due in the daily dropshipping task does not alter the fallback behavior for finding and independently starting available work.
The daily product quantity does not change where completed task artifacts or supporting links must be stored.
The product target does not change the required ClickUp status actions for subtasks or goal parent tasks.
The source context concerns products in the daily dropshipping task, not the cadence or deadline for Airbnb host outreach.
The daily dropshipping product count does not affect completion or visibility of the CRM structure document.
The candidate already contains a complete same-message MODIFY setting required_products_per_day to 20, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
The source establishes a dropshipping product quantity and does not change the content bank artifact, intended use, or deadline.
The listing Requirement already applies to selected products; changing the daily research quantity does not alter its publication destination, sequence, or category rules.
The source specifies the daily product-task quantity but does not change TikTok Shop listing coverage or method, which already applies to all selected products.
The quantity of products to complete does not change the spreadsheet's cross-channel tracking structure.
The daily dropshipping product target is unrelated to visibility of shared credentials in Bitwarden.
The source concerns a dropshipping product count and does not alter the required follow-up for interested Airbnb hosts.
